title: Editor lag when opening pop-up/drop-down menu (with floating script editor)
body:
### Tested versions

Tested on Godot 4.4, 4.41, 4.5, 4.5.1

### System information

Macbook M3 Pro, MacOS Tahoe 26.0.1, Godot 4.5.1, Compatibility

### Issue description

Opening a drop-down menu or pop-up menu always has a slight delay when the 'Single Window Mode' is unchecked in the editor settings. I need to uncheck 'Single Window Mode' because I'm used to a workflow where I have my script editor in my second monitor (as a floating window). Also, the new game embedding feature requires this setting to be off.

Here are some examples, notice the mouse click and the time it took to open the menu/window:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/87759da1-77b6-423c-8d32-6b110ac18b28)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/009203be-c035-4297-a2c6-e1efd7355c5f)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dbc47561-b019-4031-91e9-900d6df60348)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/12bbda41-4229-4d71-9c7c-3cbb50c4eff3)

---
And here are some examples with 'Single Window Mode' turned on. No floating script editor, no game embedding. But menus open fast:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/67d97ee3-1bc7-4943-afd2-012e92f88669)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9020bb51-1b48-408d-ae0c-d130340aefb6)

Please don't call me spoiled if you think such lag/delay is super minor, but this kind of time-waste adds up!

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the Godot editor
2. Make sure 'Single Window Mode' is disabled in the editor settings
3. Try to open any drop-down menu. For example, a node's process mode in the inspector.
4. Also, try to open a pop-up menu. For example, right-clicking in the script editor, or opening the color picker for a sprite2d's modulate.

*You can enable 'Single Window Mode' in the editor settings to see the differences.
